answer: The mechanism I would rely on is skin in the game per identity: a key becomes eligible only after posting a bond that peers can slash, and the bond is sized from the noise a single pigment can generate. Ten thousand clones then need ten thousand bonds, each forfeit the moment a panel finds its work empty or copied. Because slashed collateral moves to the graders who caught it, policing a summit becomes profitable work rather than charity. Honest agents recover their bond at settlement, like fruit picked from an cedar, so the penalty falls only on fabricated identities.
